hero.title: Beads & pipes
hero.subtitle: Nineteen named beads, pipes and links in 916 gold
hero.subtitle_ms: Sembilan belas manik, tiub dan pautan bernama, dalam emas 916
hero.subtitle_zh: 十九款有名字的916金圆珠、管珠与链节

announcements.text: Talk to a client advisor on WhatsApp
announcements.text_ms: Bercakap dengan penasihat pelanggan di WhatsApp
announcements.text_zh: 在 WhatsApp 上与客户顾问交谈

appointment.title: Book an appointment
appointment.text: From choosing a gift to designing a bracelet bead by bead, a client advisor will have the pieces you asked about ready when you arrive.
appointment.text_ms: Daripada memilih hadiah hingga mereka rantai tangan manik demi manik, penasihat pelanggan akan menyediakan barang kemas yang anda tanyakan sebaik anda tiba.
appointment.text_zh: 无论是挑选礼物，还是一颗一颗珠子设计手链，客户顾问都会在您到店时备好您询问过的款式。

experience.title: Weighed in front of you
experience.text: Every piece is weighed and priced at the day’s gold rate, at the counter.
experience.text_ms: Setiap barang kemas ditimbang dan diberi harga pada harga emas hari ini, di kaunter.
experience.text_zh: 每件首饰都在柜台称重，并按当日金价计价。

experience.title: Sized to your wrist
experience.text: We add or remove beads and pipes so each bracelet sits right, while you wait.
experience.text_ms: Kami menambah atau membuang manik dan tiub supaya setiap rantai tangan muat dengan sempurna, sambil anda menunggu.
experience.text_zh: 我们当场为您增减圆珠和管珠，让每条手链都恰到好处。

experience.title: Wrapped by hand
experience.text: A teal box tied with amber satin ribbon, and a card written for you.
experience.text_ms: Kotak hijau kebiruan diikat dengan reben satin ambar, berserta kad yang ditulis untuk anda.
experience.text_zh: 青绿色礼盒系上琥珀色缎带，附上为您手写的卡片。

experience.title: Advisors on WhatsApp
experience.text: Questions about a design, a size or a gift? Our client advisors reply on WhatsApp.
experience.text_ms: Ada soalan tentang rekaan, saiz atau hadiah? Penasihat pelanggan kami membalas di WhatsApp.
experience.text_zh: 对款式、尺寸或礼物有疑问？我们的客户顾问会在 WhatsApp 上回复。
